The five English versions split on the closing 'pits': ASV 'whence they shall not rise', BBE 'deep waters'. I follow Strong's H4113 'pits' and note that the word is a hapax of disputed meaning.

agent_notes: 'zemamo' occurs only here. The sense 'his plot' follows Rashi and Metzudat Zion; the Rabbinic reading 'muzzle' (Rashi citing Genesis Rabbah) is noted in the commentary as an alternative. Targum and Rashi name Doeg and Amalek in this verse; I cite them in the notes only where the packet supplies the text.
